name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring early progressive land scaling (14-16 plots), strict Strawberry acreage protection, pre-glut oracle frontrunning, fluid capital-velocity liquidations, and deadlock-free post-drop-off fertilization.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Procures exact seed quantities respecting crop maturation windows, strictly protects perennial Strawberry acreage, and delivers high-margin late-game contracts from surplus inventory.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices below fair market value.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus inventory at favorable market prices, unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment while preserving gross margins.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into workforce scaling (up to 10 hands), progressive contiguous land expansion (14-16 plots max by Day 18), and hyper-fertilized recurring cash crops (Strawberries) for maximum multi-harvest compounding.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with cluster harvesting to minimize transit waste. Sequences shed drop-off prior to fertilizer application and seed restocking to eliminate inventory lock and maximize worker productivity.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve ((n_animals * 3) if n_animals > 0 else 0); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 180.0 and active_shop_demand > 0)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through step 710. Procure exact seed quantities (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) strictly to fulfill active unlocked contracts within maturation windows: halt Pumpkin seeds after Day 14, Tomato seeds after Day 18, and Carrot seeds after Day 26. After Day 24, fulfill contracts strictly from existing shed surplus.
attributes.pitfalls: Never uproot or replace living Strawberry plots to plant shop crops; do not hoard inventory speculatively for unrevealed contracts; do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll.

attributes.guidance: Preempt open market collapses: execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Strawberry, Wool, Milk) while current market price remains favorable (>= 0.80 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices over the 96-step forecast window.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.55 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; never front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings to maintain capital velocity. Sell when market price >= 0.90 * base_price when shed_used < 50 (relaxing floor to >= 0.85 * base_price if reinvestment cash is needed). If shed_used >= 50, liquidate at >= 0.80 * base_price; if shed_used >= 75, liquidate at >= 0.60 * base_price to guarantee shed headroom.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve ((n_animals * 3) if n_animals > 0 else 0).

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0 and (hired_hands < 10 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit or (plots < 16 and day <= 18)) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce to 10 hands. Progressively expand contiguous land to 14-16 plots between Days 6 and 18: expand to 10-12 plots once hands >= 5, and to 14-16 plots once hands >= 8, strictly gated by cash > 2.0x midnight payroll + plot cost. Transition all non-shop acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries, maintaining steady fertilizer stock in the shed.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land beyond 16 plots or after Day 18 to avoid escalating plot costs and transit sprawl. Do not plant slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) unless explicitly demanded by an active town shop contract. Ensure persistent fertilizer procurement for all Strawberry plots.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands using cluster harvesting: workers must harvest adjacent ready plots up to inventory capacity before routing to the shed. Priority sequence: 1) Cluster Harvest, 2) Water dry crops, 3) Drop off inventory at shed, 4) Restock & field tasks from shed (feed livestock, retrieve and apply fertilizer to unfertilized Strawberry plots, plant seeds, weed/till). Ensure all carried inventory is deposited by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never deprioritize watering below shed transit, as dry plots halt growth. Do not attempt field fertilization before clearing carried inventory at the shed. NEVER till under, uproot, or overwrite living perennial Strawberry plots. Ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain.
